correctedDuringAcceptance.issue: Sorting wide JSON columns in audit exceeded MySQL sort memory
correctedDuringAcceptance.fix: Read unsorted JSON rows; sort in audit process without changing database memory settings

correctedDuringAcceptance.issue: MySQL JSON float roundtrip changes last digits and cannot retain original response bytes
correctedDuringAcceptance.fix: Add nullable LONGTEXT evidence envelope, keep source bodyText plus hashes, use adapterVersion 2 query keys; preserve and exclude old version from query reuse
correctedDuringAcceptance.legacyLimitation: 17 JSON-only snapshots retained; 15 cannot reproduce old content hashes. No claim of byte verification for those snapshots.

limitations: Unofficial public website API; no formal integration contract verified
Scope is source metadata current 18.4b, queue 1100, last 3 days, platinum+; statistics response does not echo patch
Candidate endpoints may truncate; SQL sorting and minimum apply to returned candidates, not guaranteed exhaustive optimum
Sample observations are not unique match IDs; different rows and snapshots may overlap
Traits are not supported by this adapter and return an explicit error
Unknown or failed requests do not switch source or broaden conditions
Metadata refresh 60 seconds; full-query snapshot TTL 10 minutes; no offline stale fallback
Source stability, rate limits, other modes and long-duration load not fully validated
No model or embedding provider calls; Milvus remains the existing knowledge index
